events.name: US Fed (FOMC)
events.effect: Sets global risk appetite & the dollar — dovish → FII inflows to India; hawkish → outflows, INR pressure.

events.name: RBI MPC
events.effect: Rate/stance decision — a cut or dovish tone lifts rate-sensitives (banks, autos); a hawkish hold pressures them.

events.name: US CPI
events.effect: Hot CPI → higher-for-longer rates, risk-off for EM equities; cool CPI → supportive. (Date approx.)

events.name: India CPI
events.effect: Feeds the RBI's next move — cooler inflation opens room to cut. (Date approx.)
